title: Tim Truman
description: "I've always wondered about the culture and background of the Tusken Raiders," comments Tim Truman. "Are they indigenous to Tatooine? Maybe we'll find out in the next trilogy..." Truman, an accomplished guitarist and songwriter in addition to being an artist, broke into comics with back-up stories for SGT. ROCK in 1980. Since then, his work has included GRIMJACK (co-created with John Ostrander), TIME BEAVERS, SCOUT, AIRBOY, THE SPIDER and his own retro-pulp concept, THE PROWLER. More recent projects include JONAH HEX, TUROK, an updated HAWKMAN (for DC's HAWKWORLD), GRATEFUL DEAD COMIX for Kitchen Sink and THE LONE RANGER for Topps.
